question: The sum of the age of A and 4 times the age of B is 37 years. When 7 times the age of A is added to 6 times the age of B, the result is 61 years. The sum of the ages (in years) of A and B is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the ages of **A** and **B** be **A** and **B** years respectively.

Given: **A + 4B = 37** and **7A + 6B = 61**.

Multiply the first equation by 7: **7A + 28B = 259**.

Subtract the second equation from this: **(7A + 28B) − (7A + 6B) = 259 − 61** ⇒ **22B = 198** ⇒ **B = 9**.

Substitute **B = 9** in the first equation: **A + 4(9) = 37** ⇒ **A = 37 − 36 = 1**.

Sum of ages = **1 + 9 = 10**.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67251d7e146ccfaa5c77d7febec0342bdbf3d6fb890f00ca5db818cc1ad819df.png] 

**Given:**

Equation 1: **A + 4B = 37**

Equation 2: **7A + 6B = 61**

**Calculations:**

⇒ From (1): **A = 37 − 4B**

⇒ Substitute in (2): **7(37 − 4B) + 6B = 61**

⇒ **259 − 28B + 6B = 61**

⇒ **259 − 22B = 61**

⇒ **22B = 198**

⇒ **B = 9**

⇒ Now, **A = 37 − 4(9) = 37 − 36 = 1**

⇒ Sum of ages = **A + B = 1 + 9 = 10**

**∴ The correct answer is 10 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equations in Two Variables

Problems involving two unknowns require a system of two independent equations to find unique values for each variable.

Elimination Method

Multiply equations by suitable constants so that the coefficients of one variable become equal, allowing its removal by subtraction or addition.

Ages Concept

If the current age is **x**, then age **n** years ago was **x − n** and age **n** years hence will be **x + n**.</p
